description: Oracle Database is a multi-model database management system produced and marketed by Oracle Corporation.

alternatives.name: PostgreSQL
alternatives.reason: Free, open-source, enterprise-grade, most Oracle features available

alternatives.name: MySQL
alternatives.reason: Popular open-source database, easier to set up than Oracle, good for web apps

alternatives.name: Amazon RDS
alternatives.reason: Managed database service, supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, and more

migrationGuide: Use Oracle's export tools (exp/expdp) to extract data as SQL or CSV. Then import into PostgreSQL using tools like Ora2Pg (free, open-source). For large migrations, consider a professional migration service.

faqs.question: Is PostgreSQL compatible with Oracle SQL?

faqs.question: Can I run Oracle and PostgreSQL in parallel during migration?
faqs.answer: Yes, many organizations run both in parallel and gradually migrate users and applications.
